item.summary: Union Minister for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Shri Jitan Ram Manjhi, inaugurated the Ministry of MSME, Khadi & Village Industries Commission (KVIC), COIR and National SC-ST Hub (NSSH) Pavilions in Hall No. 6 at the 45 th India International Trade Fair (IITF) at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, today. item.title: Union Minister of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Shri Jitan Ram Manjhi inaugurates MSME, KVIC, COIR and NSSH Pavilions at the 45th India International Trade Fair
